# Lane 2.224 — the two-league test sees the code's own fence (D-M1)

Builder's note, 2026-11-23. Branch `lane/2.224-fence-test`. No query, store or migration changed.

## Built

- **Arrange inside the target's own fence** (`isolation-registry/-harness.test-helper.ts`): a case's `arrange` runs before every run, as the app role with the database set to league B and B's owner (rows' triggers held, since `updated_at` reads the real clock); each run is judged against the database as arranged, read once per case.
- **Cases arranged:** every public read that opened B's season and both read stores; postponed games (query, command); games needing a result and earlier rounds; the bin (list, purge, restores, binned game parts: one of each kind in B's bin plus a court, team and person nothing points at, fixed ids); the draft insert (B's draft discarded first); "the league's own" reads (`findCurrentLeague`, `findLeagueAudience`, `findLeagueTimeZone`, `findLeagueToday`, `leagueDayOf`, and the roster's audience read: B set to another time zone and audience, A's row moved after B's). `find-public-team` asks by the seed's short name (`LeagueRecords.teamSlug`).
- **Fixed SQL clock:** `now()` in a query answers `harnessNow` (a `harness_clock.now()` searched first), set before seeding. The seeded support visit keeps the real clock (a database trigger starts it).
- **Standing check:** `node scripts/fence-filter-check.mjs [files | file#n] [--jobs=N] | --list | --excused`: each filter out in turn, in a temporary copy of `packages/database` (never a tracked file; removed also on SIGINT/SIGTERM); "caught" only when the group fails on its assertion, else "error". `tests/fence-filter-check.test.mjs` (in `npm test`) holds the excused list to 4 and runs the 13 confirmed gaps by name (~65 s, 3 at a time).

## What the test found

- **No leak in the product.** With every filter in place all 297 groups pass in all five runs; every failure seen came from a filter taken out on purpose. Nothing to cure in `packages/database`.
- **All 13 of the audit's confirmed gaps are now caught** with their filter out: list-public-roster#1 (fix round: A's own roster, a player of unknown age, B set to youth) and #2, find-public-team, list-public-games, find-public-season, find-public-game-facts, list-public-teams, list-postponed-games, list-binned#1 (and #2 to #6), purge-binned#2 (venues, and #1, #7, #8), restore-binned-game, has-binned-game-part, insert-schedule-draft#1 (and #2). Also caught: restore-binned-person, list-season-stat-keys, list-public-seasons.

3. Excuse with quoted reasons list-season-teams#1-3, games-for-lists#2-5, list-public-schedule#1 (guarded by an earlier league-filtered read); inspect list-games-in-window#1 and list-earlier-rounds#1-3.
4. `arrange` for command cases and for has-recorded-child, update-game-not-started, list-refused-adds, change-table-player, remove-table-player; cases for the statements no case reaches.
5. The whole sweep as a GitHub job; the remaining real clocks (`statement_timestamp()` in find-game-ended-ago.ts, `new Date()` in the set-\*-binned queries and remove-table-player).
